citation.concept: Pneumatic Air Dryer Protection Product Family

canonical.definition:
Pneumatic Air Dryer Protection — the DRYCORE™-technology air-dryer filtration
element family for pneumatic brake-system moisture control, covering 16 SKUs.
canonical.systems:
Compressed-air domain within Air Intake & Airflow Protection; implements
DRYCORE™ air-dryer filtration technology
canonical.failure_impact:
Inadequate moisture removal in compressed air allows condensation to affect
pneumatic valves, actuators and braking-system components, risking corrosion
and reduced reliability.
canonical.related_technologies:
None -- DRYCORE is the sole ELIMFILTERS technology assigned to the
compressed-air / pneumatic-brake domain.
canonical.industrial_role:
This product family is the principal moisture-control implementation for
ELIMFILTERS pneumatic brake-system protection.
